claim: Sample data stays separate from your real log.
sandbox: Create a real source, enter /demo, then return to the real log and verify each log only contains its own data.

claim: Log books, podcasts, videos, articles, and other language sources.
sandbox: Open /demo, inspect the realistic multi-media sample, then save an Other source.

claim: Understanding ratings are personal observations, not proficiency scores.
sandbox: Open /demo, open the source form, and select a visible understanding band.

claim: See an understanding trend and a next-source suggestion.
sandbox: Open /demo and move from its populated log to Trends.

claim: Keep source entries in this browser after a reload.
sandbox: Add a source in /demo, reload, and observe the saved source.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo, waits for the service worker, goes offline, then reloads.

claim: Export the input log as a JSON backup.
sandbox: Open /demo, export JSON, and inspect its four sample records.

claim: Export the input log as CSV.
sandbox: Open /demo, export CSV, and assert its header plus one row per sample record.

claim: Preview an import before it replaces the current log.
sandbox: Open /demo, select a valid backup, observe the replacement dialog, and cancel it.

claim: Try the log for free without an account.
sandbox: Open /demo in a fresh browser context and use the populated sample without authentication or payment.

claim: The app has no account or analytics requests.
sandbox: Record all requests during the /demo flow and assert they remain same-origin.

claim: The app does not upload or host study media.
sandbox: Save a source in /demo while recording requests and assert no non-GET request occurs.
